China's YMTC ranks among top 3 global NAND flash memory suppliers

Yangtze Memory Technologies Corp (YMTC), a China-based company, has entered the global top three NAND flash memory suppliers by volume for the first time. This achievement signifies a milestone in China's semiconductor industry aspirations, aiming to reduce the revenue difference with international competitors in the data-center storage market. YMTC has surpassed Kioxia in NAND shipments, according to a report.
